mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( from_id, to_id, content_type, content_id, operation, operation_time ) VALUES ( #{fromId}, #{toId}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{operation}, now() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, from_id, to_id, content_type, content_id, operation, operation_time FROM notification WHERE to_id = #{toId} ORDER BY operation_time DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{size}
